import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the existing videos table
videos = pxt.get_table("videos")

# Create a view that expands each video into one row per frame at 1 fps
frames_view = pxt.create_view(
    "video_frames",
    videos,
    select=[
        videos.video,
        pxt.iterate(
            pxt.extract_frames(videos.video, fps=1)
        ).alias("frame"),
    ]
)

# Access the view
frame_data = pxt.get_table("video_frames")
print(frame_data.show())

```python
import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the existing videos table
videos = pxt.get_table("videos")

# Create a view that expands each video into one row per frame at 1 fps
frames_view = pxt.create_view(
    "video_frames",
    videos,
    select=[
        videos.video,
        pxt.iterate(
            pxt.extract_frames(videos.video, fps=1)
        ).alias("frame"),
    ]
)

# Access the view
frame_data = pxt.get_table("video_frames")
print(frame_data.show())
```
